title: Student protest in Tiananmen Square
title_zh: 天安门广场上的学生抗议
caption: Student protesters carry banners past the Monument to the People’s Heroes in Tiananmen Square.
caption_zh: 参加抗议的学生举着横幅，从天安门广场上的人民英雄纪念碑旁走过。
alt: Demonstrators carrying banners and a red flag cross the square in front of the monument.
image_note: Wikimedia records the photographer’s permission under this license. The available file is 299 × 199 pixels.

title: Protest at the Chinese embassy in Poland
title_zh: 波兰中国大使馆外的抗议
caption: Protesters gather outside the Chinese embassy in Poland after the crackdown in Beijing. A Polish-language banner reads “Against terror in China.”
caption_zh: 北京发生镇压后，抗议者聚集在中国驻波兰大使馆外。一条波兰语横幅写着“反对中国的恐怖镇压”。
alt: Protesters sit beneath protest banners outside the Chinese embassy in Poland.
image_note: The detail image is the Commons file. The gallery thumbnail is resized.

title: Demonstration in The Hague
caption: Demonstrators carry banners at a march and memorial in The Hague for people killed in the crackdown in China.
caption_zh: 示威者在海牙举着横幅游行，悼念在中国镇压中遇难的人。
alt: Two demonstrators raise their fists as others hold banners behind them.
image_note: The archive uses resized copies of the Wikimedia Commons file.

title: Memorial in The Hague
caption: A participant crouches beside a memorial covered with flowers during a gathering in The Hague for victims of the crackdown.
caption_zh: 在海牙悼念六四遇难者的集会上，一名参与者蹲在摆满鲜花的纪念牌旁。
alt: A participant wearing a headband crouches beside flowers and a memorial plaque.
image_note: The archive uses resized copies of the Wikimedia Commons file.

title: Zhongguancun Street, Beijing
caption: A burned-out vehicle on Zhongguancun Street in Beijing in the days after the military crackdown.
caption_zh: 六四镇压后的几天，北京中关村大街上一辆烧毁的车辆。
alt: Cyclists pass a burned-out vehicle on Zhongguancun Street.
date_note: The photographer’s description gives this range. The Commons date field lists June 10.
image_note: The archive uses resized copies of the photographer’s original upload.

title: Renmin University’s east gate
caption: A burned-out car stands outside the east gate of Renmin University in the days after the crackdown.
caption_zh: 镇压后的几天，一辆烧毁的汽车停在中国人民大学东门外。
alt: Cyclists cross a tree-lined road near a burned-out car outside the university gate.
image_note: The archive uses resized copies of the Wikimedia Commons file.
date_note: The photographer’s description gives this range. The Commons date field lists June 7.

title: Peking University’s south gate
caption: A wide view of the south gate of Peking University, with mourning banners hanging from the gate after the crackdown.
caption_zh: 六四镇压后，北京大学南门悬挂悼念横幅的全景。
alt: People and bicycles pass through the entrance beneath long vertical banners.
image_note: The archive uses resized copies of the Wikimedia Commons file.
date_note: The photographer’s description gives this range. The Commons date field lists June 7.

title: Peking University’s south gate, second view
title_zh: 北京大学南门的另一视角
caption: A second view of Peking University’s south gate shows people and bicycles beneath the mourning banners.
caption_zh: 从另一角度拍摄的北京大学南门，行人和自行车经过悬挂的悼念横幅。
alt: The sunlit gate and its vertical banners stand beyond people crossing the road.
image_note: The archive uses resized copies of the Wikimedia Commons file.
date_note: The photographer’s description gives this range. The Commons date field lists June 7.

title: The right-hand banner at Peking University
title_zh: 北京大学南门右侧的悼念横幅
caption: Daiwenchen’s portrait-oriented photograph shows the mourning banner on the right side of Peking University’s south gate.
caption_zh: Daiwenchen拍摄的竖幅照片，记录了北京大学南门右侧悬挂的悼念横幅。
alt: Banners and dark fabric hang down the right pillar as people below look toward the gate.
image_note: The archive uses resized copies of the Wikimedia Commons file.
date_note: The photographer’s description gives this range. The Commons date field lists June 7.

title: The left-hand banner at Peking University
title_zh: 北京大学南门左侧的悼念横幅
caption: A close view of the banner on the left side of Peking University’s south gate shows a tribute to those killed.
caption_zh: 北京大学南门左侧横幅的近景，横幅上的文字悼念遇难者。
alt: A close view of a long handwritten banner beside a pillar and people standing with bicycles.
image_note: The archive uses resized copies of the Wikimedia Commons file.
date_note: The photographer’s description gives this range. The Commons date field lists June 7.

title: Wall posters on Zhongguancun Street
caption: Handwritten posters cover a brick wall on Zhongguancun Street in the days after the crackdown.
caption_zh: 镇压后的几天，北京中关村大街的砖墙上贴着手写墙报。
alt: Handwritten notices are pasted across a brick wall behind a tree and parked bicycles.
image_note: The archive uses resized copies of the Wikimedia Commons file.
date_note: The photographer’s description gives this range. The Commons date field lists June 7.

title: Posters and bicycles on Zhongguancun Street
title_zh: 中关村大街的墙报和自行车
caption: Pedestrians and bicycles line a stretch of Zhongguancun Street where handwritten posters have been put up.
caption_zh: 中关村大街的一段路边贴着手写墙报，墙边有行人和自行车。
alt: Bicycles fill the foreground, with several people standing by posters on the wall.
image_note: The archive uses resized copies of the Wikimedia Commons file.
date_note: The photographer’s description gives this range. The Commons date field lists June 7.

title: Reading posters on Zhongguancun Street
title_zh: 在中关村大街阅读墙报
caption: People stop to read handwritten posters on Zhongguancun Street in the days after the crackdown.
caption_zh: 镇压后的几天，人们在中关村大街驻足阅读手写墙报。
alt: Several people face a wall covered with notices, with bicycles along the sidewalk.
image_note: The detail image is a Wikimedia Commons resize. The archive uses a smaller copy in the gallery.
date_note: The photographer’s description gives this range. The Commons date field lists June 7.

title: Tanks in Beijing, July 1989
caption: Chinese tanks stand in formation in Beijing in July 1989, seen from the U.S. diplomatic compound.
caption_zh: 1989年7月，从美国驻华外交机构院内拍摄到列队停放在北京街头的中国坦克。
alt: Tanks form lines on a broad roadway viewed from above.
photographer: Pete Campolongo / U.S. Department of State
image_note: The detail image is the file as published on Wikimedia Commons.
